--> Following a strip sack late in the second quarter, LaNorris Sellers had to be helped off the field. He now heads to the locker room for further evalutation. 
 Sellers and the Gamecocks offense began clicking in the second quarter. He was 10/15 for 151 yards and a touchdown before going down. It is unclear the severity of the injury right now.
